gloss: drastically; completely; with one clean cut

definitions.explanation: Describes cutting something off completely or making a decisive, drastic change.
Describes the sound or manner of cutting something cleanly and decisively.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}をばっさり{切|き}った。
examples.english: I cut my hair drastically short.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}がばっさり{削|けず}られた。
{彼|かれ}の{提案|ていあん}はばっさり{却下|きゃっか}された。
{庭|にわ}の{木|き}の{枝|えだ}をばっさり{切|き}り{落|お}とした。
examples.english: I cleanly cut off the tree branches in the garden.

examples.japanese: {刀|かたな}でばっさりと{斬|き}られた。
examples.english: He was cut down with one clean stroke of the sword.

notes:
NUANCE:
ばっさり conveys decisiveness and finality—a clean, complete cut or elimination without hesitation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばっさり{切|き}る: to cut drastically/decisively
- ばっさり{削|けず}る: to cut drastically (budget, etc.)
- ばっさり{断|ことわ}る: to flatly refuse
- ばっさり{捨|す}てる: to throw away completely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すっぱり: cleanly, completely (for quitting habits)
- きっぱり: flatly, decisively (for statements)
- さっぱり: refreshingly (after cleaning up)
